nodes.title: Convert established observation zones to UTC row by row
nodes.summary: Deliver public to_utc(result), returning a new four-member ObservationResult whose rows with established IANA identifiers or fixed offsets are converted by each row's own published time_zone to exact naive UTC wall-clock values paired with time_zone '+00:00', while preserving provenance, issues, raw payload, column order, and the provider-free five-column observation schema. Promote no offset to an IANA identifier, never consult the catalogue for a station zone, and convert station or product spans containing several distinct offsets row by row without rejecting them. Before any conversion, atomically detect time_zone == 'unknown' as the only rejection condition and raise with the exact affected-row count and the provider obtained from ObservationResult.provenance.provider_id, returning no partially converted result. Acceptance evidence includes public-export and four-member preservation tests; exact fixed-offset and IANA conversion tests; an unknown-zone test proving the provider and count diagnostic and atomic refusal; and a USGS DST-boundary fixture whose rows carry both -06:00 and -05:00 and convert to their exact corresponding UTC instants with '+00:00' on every row, no error, no IANA promotion, and no tz_cd abbreviation or catalogue lookup.
